cohort: Pregnant women delivering between 37+0 and 42+6 weeks gestational age with a singleton, nonanomalous fetus
finding: A universal 36-week scan policy was associated with a reduction in the incidence of undiagnosed term breech presentation but did not reduce the overall incidence of breech presentation at birth.
mod_finding: Vaginal breech birth rates fell from 10.3% to 5.3% after the introduction of the universal 36-week scan policy.
